job_detail.timeline_content: Each step shows what Syrus did: planning, writing code, opening a pull request. Click a step to see the agent's full transcript.
job_detail.approve_content: Once you've reviewed the pull request, click Approve to queue it for merging. Syrus handles the rest.
job_detail.feedback_content: Not quite right? Submit feedback in plain language — Syrus will open a new implementation attempt based on your comments.
job_detail.pr_content: The pull request link takes you straight to GitHub to review the exact code changes before you approve.
